title: Gaia Data Release 3: stars with good parallaxes, brightest first
provider: European Space Agency, Gaia mission (DPAC); distances from Bailer-Jones et al. (2021)
query: LEFT OUTER JOIN external.gaiaedr3_distance AS d ON d.source_id = g.source_id

limit.description: Maximum number of stars; the brightest are taken first

parallax_min.description: Smallest parallax in mas; the farthest distance is 1000 / parallax_min pc

parallax_snr_min.description: Smallest parallax / error; 5 means distances good to about 20 per cent

small.description: The 200 000 brightest stars with parallaxes better than 20 per cent

nearby.description: Stars within 100 pc with parallaxes better than 10 per cent, to the faintest Gaia magnitudes

medium.description: The 1 000 000 brightest stars with parallaxes better than 20 per cent

format: CSV; positions for epoch J2016.0 (ICRS); parallax in mas; r_med_geo in pc
coverage: Gaia DR3: about 1.8 billion sources, 1.5 billion with parallaxes
licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO (ESA Gaia data); acknowledge ESA Gaia and DPAC
citation: Gaia Collaboration, Vallenari, A., et al. (2023). Gaia Data Release 3: Summary of the content and survey properties. A&A 674, A1. Distances: Bailer-Jones, C. A. L., et al. (2021). AJ 161, 147.
